card.name: Gut and organ words before condition terms
card.fires_on: Words naming the gut or an organ (intestinal, GI, renal, colonic) placed just before a condition such as obstruction, ulceration or stenosis in warnings and contraindications. Also fires on 'of' after 'use' in the postmarketing section.

modes.description: The word 'of' after 'postapproval use' before a drug name.
